name: todo-api

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each user's todos (title, done flag, owner, creation time).

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in client; the gateway validates tokens issued for it.

description: The single backend: creates a todo, lists the caller's todos newest first, and marks one done (final). Every row is scoped to the signed-in caller taken from the gateway assertion. Owns the todo database; deploys separately from the browser app because it holds the data. Does not issue tokens, edit or delete todos.
